name: Hakari Mari
source:
"Leave the troublesome to me, the class president~"

A bossy class president who works at a family restaurant after school. Though she strives to become a perfect lady, she is actually clumsy and always causing trouble. After awakening an ability due to a certain incident, she can visualize the "weight of sin" in others.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294690/Yomegami_My_Sweet_Goddess/]Steam[/url]]
